title: Signal Decoder
summary: Convert text from a survey export into numbers and TRUE/FALSE with as.numeric() and as.logical().
hints: `as.numeric(ages_text)` converts each piece of text to a number. Text that isn't a number becomes `NA`, with a warning.
`is.na(ages)` is TRUE where a value is missing, so `sum(is.na(ages))` counts them.
`as.logical(consent_text)` turns "TRUE"/"FALSE" text into real logical values you can `sum()`.
